title: Find gaps in Toronto fire-station service coverage (Etobicoke)
method: Re-project both EPSG:4326 layers to a metric CRS (NAD83 / UTM 17N, EPSG:26917); buffer all 84 stations by 2 500 m (original code's distance), dissolve, subtract from the Etobicoke district polygons; save buffers, no-service polygons and a map.
benchmark_defects: No buffer distance is given in the instruction (2500 appears only in the published reference script); checks infer the radius used by the solution instead of fixing it.
Dataset description names 'fire_stations.geojson'; the file is 'fire_station.geojson'.

Inputs are in EPSG:4326; the published reference script calls buffer(2500) without re-projecting, so the distance is taken in the layer's units (degrees), and it writes its outputs into the dataset/ folder instead of pred_results/.
'etobicoke.geojson' is the Etobicoke York planning district (3 sections, 189 km2), not the former municipality.
checks: required: a saved polygon vector holds a non-empty no-service area >= 98 % inside Etobicoke
required: radius searched over 400-5000 m - the gap matches Etobicoke minus all station buffers of that radius (IoU >= 0.85) and <= 0.5 % of it lies within 0.9 d of any station (subset constraint)
optional: gap equals the gold 2500 m gap (IoU >= 0.85)
optional: buffered stations saved as a file
required (part of radius check): not a Web-Mercator distance (code uses 3857, radius = round distance x cos 43.7 deg)
